description: scipy.stats.qmc.Sobol(d, scramble, rng=seed) (bits=30): random_base2(m), and successive random(n) calls. With an integer rng SciPy uses Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence(seed).spawn(1)[0]))

comparison.why: unscrambled: Joe-Kuo direction numbers (SciPy's table) and the Gray-code recurrence are integer operations, the scale 2^-30 is exact. Scrambled: SciPy's LMS + digital shift with bits from Generator.integers(0, 2, dtype=uint32), ported exactly; this agreement holds for the recorded SciPy/NumPy versions and is promised only statistically across versions
